findings.title: No API Interface — Direct Database Access Required
findings.description: The application is a Win32 desktop EXE (VB6) that connects directly to a Microsoft Access .mdb file on an SMB network share. There is no REST, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, or any programmatic interface. Integration requires direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No API exists. The only integration path is direct Access database manipulation via OLEDB/ODBC or RPA against the desktop UI.
findings.recommendation: Design and implement a REST API layer that exposes customer CRUD operations, wrapping the existing database. Migrate from Access .mdb to a supported database.

findings.title: No Idempotency on Write Operations
findings.description: The INSERT operation has no idempotency controls. No idempotency key, no unique constraint enforcement, no deduplication logic. Repeated submissions create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists. Agent retries would create duplicate customer records.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key support in write endpoints. Add unique business key constraints.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Single hardcoded database password shared by all users. No service accounts, OAuth2 client credentials, API keys, mTLS, or any machine identity authentication.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication exists. An agent cannot be uniquely identified or attributed.
findings.recommendation: Implement centralized identity provider (Cognito, Okta) with OAuth2 client credentials flow for machine-to-machine authentication.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: Zero logging of any kind. No audit trail for any operation. On Error Resume Next silently swallows all errors without recording them.
findings.gap: No audit logging, no immutable storage, no principal attribution in logs.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudTrail and application-level structured audit logging with immutable storage (S3 Object Lock).

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No transaction management, no saga pattern, no compensation logic, no undo capability. Database corrupts monthly from concurrent access.
findings.gap: No rollback or compensation mechanism. Failed agent workflows leave database in partial/corrupt state.
findings.recommendation: Implement database transactions with commit/rollback semantics. Design compensation endpoints for multi-step workflows.

findings.title: Unscoped Sensitive Data Access
findings.description: System stores customer PII. The only integration path (direct database access) exposes ALL fields in ALL tables without filtering. Single shared password provides full access to everything.
findings.gap: B1: No mechanism to scope agent data access — direct DB access exposes all fields. B2: Single shared password with no role differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement API layer with field-level scoping and access control differentiation. Separate DTOs for agent-facing responses.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Customer data resides on SMB file share with no residency controls, no region configuration, no data sovereignty policies. No restrictions on data transmission.
findings.gap: No data residency policies, no region controls, no egress restrictions.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Implement region-locked storage with egress controls when migrating to cloud.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes only an HTML web interface (index.cfm, download.cfm) served by Adobe ColdFusion 8 on IIS 7. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI endpoints exist. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No API exists. Only HTML pages served by IIS/ColdFusion. Integration requires brittle RPA or direct database coupling.
findings.recommendation: Design and implement a REST API layer exposing document search and download as JSON endpoints with OpenAPI documentation.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency keys, no duplicate detection, no unique constraints on business keys for write operations.
findings.gap: Write operations will create duplicates on agent retry. No at-most-once semantics.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to all write endpoints with unique constraint enforcement.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Session-based authentication only (cfapplication sessionmanagement with session.userid check). No OAuth2 client credentials, no API keys, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: Agents cannot authenticate without human credentials. No machine identity support.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow or API key authentication with per-agent principal attribution.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no CloudWatch, no application-level logging of write operations or authenticated principals.
findings.gap: Zero audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics for any operation.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail. Implement application-level structured audit logging with caller identity for all operations.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanisms. No saga patterns, no undo endpoints, no compensating transactions, no error handling.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step operations leave system in partial, unrecoverable state.
findings.recommendation: Implement transactional boundaries around write operations. Add soft-delete and undo capability.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: Stage A: System stores user-specific data (userid, fullname, uploaded_by, corporate documents). Stage B — B1: All fields returned without filtering. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.gap: Agent-facing responses expose all data indiscriminately. No field-level scoping or access differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level filtering on API responses. Separate response DTOs for different access levels.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Corporate documents and user data stored on local disk (D:\docroot\files) and SQL Server on single EC2. No residency configuration, no compliance framework, no region constraints.
findings.gap: No controls preventing cross-border data transmission to LLM endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Classify data sensitivity. Enforce residency via VPC endpoints and service control policies.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface

findings.gap: No documented, stable API interface for agent tool binding.
findings.recommendation: Implement a proper REST API using Django REST Framework with documented JSON endpoints.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations

findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to write endpoints and enforce unique constraints on business keys.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging

findings.gap: No audit logging of authenticated principals for write operations. No immutable log storage.

findings.title: No Programmatic API — Form-Based UI Only
findings.description: The application exposes only a Struts 1.3 form-submission-based web UI at /loan. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires direct database access or UI automation.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Write Operations

findings.title: Sensitive Financial PII Exposed Without Scoping

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Financial PII

findings.gap: No data residency management for regulated financial data.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements and configure region-restriction policies.

findings.title: No Modern API Interface — SOAP RPC/Encoded Only
findings.description: The application exposes a SOAP 1.1 RPC/encoded endpoint with a hand-maintained WSDL. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Deprecated protocol not consumable by modern agent frameworks.
findings.gap: No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Only integration surface is deprecated SOAP.

findings.title: Write Operations Not Idempotent

findings.gap: No idempotency key support, no unique constraints on business keys, no deduplication logic.
findings.recommendation: Add UNIQUE constraint on (partner_id, po_number) and implement idempotency key header support.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication

findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. Partner credentials are shared with no principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow with per-agent identity and principal attribution in audit logs.

findings.title: No Audit Logging

findings.gap: Complete absence of audit logging. Cannot determine who performed any action.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with principal attribution and immutable storage (CloudTrail + S3 object lock).

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: submitOrder performs a single INSERT with no compensation or rollback. If a multi-step agent workflow fails, inserted orders cannot be undone.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no undo endpoints, no status-based lifecycle. INSERT is fire-and-forget.
findings.recommendation: Add order status lifecycle (PENDING → CONFIRMED → CANCELLED) with compensation endpoints.

findings.title: Data Residency Undocumented for Financial Transactions
findings.description: Financial transaction data (purchase orders with monetary amounts) stored with no data residency documentation or compliance framework. Cannot assess agent-to-LLM compliance.
findings.gap: Complete absence of data residency documentation for financial transaction data.
findings.recommendation: Document applicable data residency requirements and enforce region restrictions for agent data flows.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface

findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. Agent integration would require direct database access, file-based exchange, or RPA-style UI automation.
findings.recommendation: Expose payroll operations through a REST API (e.g., AWS Lambda + API Gateway) with OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations

findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key tracking and duplicate detection for payroll runs.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No machine identity authentication exists. No OAuth2, no API keys, no mTLS, no service accounts. Only hardcoded FTP credentials in JCL.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent authentication or principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement service account authentication with principal attribution (OAuth2 client credentials or IAM-based).

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit trail, no immutable log storage.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail for write operations. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with caller identity attribution in immutable storage.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanism. Batch runs to completion writing records sequentially. Partial failures leave corrupted state.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no undo capability. Failed payroll runs leave partial state.
findings.recommendation: Implement transactional batch processing with commit/rollback semantics.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped in Output
findings.description: System processes SSN (EMP-SSN PIC 9(09)), bank account numbers (EMP-ACCT PIC X(17)), and pay rates. All data written unfiltered to output. No field-level filtering or access scoping.
findings.gap: B1: Sensitive fields unfiltered in output. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No formal classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level filtering excluding SSN/bank accounts from agent-accessible output. Create separate access tiers.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Sensitive employee data (SSN, bank accounts) transmitted via plaintext FTP to EC2 gateway at 10.0.7.40. No data residency controls, no encryption in transit, no regional constraints.
findings.gap: No encryption in transit, no residency policies. Data sovereignty uncontrolled.
findings.recommendation: Replace plaintext FTP with encrypted transfer (SFTP/AWS Transfer Family). Implement data residency policies.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface — CGI Returns HTML
findings.description: The application exposes a CGI endpoint at /cgi-bin/pricing.cgi via Apache HTTP that accepts GET requests with query parameters (sku, qty). The response is Content-Type: text/html — raw HTML markup, not a structured machine-readable format. No REST API, GraphQL schema, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Agent integration requires HTML parsing.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API interface exists. The only integration surface outputs unstructured HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add a JSON response mode — accept an Accept: application/json header or format=json query parameter. Implement proper HTTP status codes for error conditions.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application has zero authentication. No OAuth2 client credentials, no API key validation, no mTLS, no authentication middleware. Any network-reachable client can call the endpoint without identity attribution. The Kubernetes deployment defines no authentication mechanism.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication exists. Agent calls cannot be attributed to a specific principal.
findings.recommendation: Deploy an API Gateway in front of the service that requires API key or OAuth2 client credentials for access. Configure principal attribution in access logs.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses a single static hardcoded API key shared by all callers with no principal attribution. All requests are indistinguishable — there is no way to identify which agent or service made a specific request.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication with per-caller attribution. No OAuth2 client credentials, no mTLS, no per-caller API keys, no service account definitions.
findings.recommendation: Replace the static shared API key with per-caller API keys that map to named principals, or implement OAuth2 client credentials flow with a Cognito app client or API Gateway authorizer.

findings.title: Undocumented REST API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes REST endpoints via a Rails 2.3 controller (GET /orders, POST /orders, GET /orders/:id), but these are entirely undocumented. No API documentation exists.
findings.gap: No API documentation. Integration requires reading source code.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all endpoints, request/response schemas, and error responses.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: POST /orders creates a new order and charges the card with no idempotency protection. No idempotency keys, no duplicate detection.
findings.gap: Agent retries would create duplicate orders and duplicate charges.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key support (Idempotency-Key header) on write endpoints.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No authentication mechanism exists. Controller comments confirm no auth filters. No OAuth2, no API keys, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: No machine identity. Any caller can access all endpoints without identification.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow with per-agent service accounts.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging

findings.gap: Agent-initiated actions are undetectable and unattributable.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging (CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock) with principal attribution for every write operation.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Multi-Step Operations
findings.description: Multi-step create+charge workflow has no compensation logic. If charge fails after order save, order remains in inconsistent state.
findings.gap: No rollback or compensation for partial failures in create+charge workflow.
findings.recommendation: Implement transactional boundary or saga pattern for the create+charge workflow.

findings.title: Unscoped Sensitive Data in API Responses
findings.description: System stores PCI card data (card_number, card_exp). SELECT * returns all fields including card data in API responses. No field filtering, no access control differentiation.
findings.gap: Agent-facing responses include unmasked credit card numbers. No access control differentiation. No classification metadata.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for PCI Data
findings.description: PCI-regulated card data with no residency controls or documentation. No mechanisms prevent cross-boundary data transmission.
findings.gap: No data residency controls for PCI-regulated card data.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements. Implement tokenization for card data. Prevent regulated data from leaving compliance boundaries.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application is a legacy ASP.NET WebForms UI (VB.NET code-behind). It exposes no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. The only interaction model is browser-based form submission with rendered HTML responses. No machine-consumable integration surface exists.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. Agent integration would require UI automation or direct database access — both are brittle, non-auditable coupling patterns.
findings.recommendation: Build a REST API exposing GET/POST /timesheets endpoints with JSON responses. Implement OAuth2 client credentials for machine access.

findings.title: Write Operations Not Idempotent
findings.description: The write operation (btnSave_Click) performs a direct INSERT INTO timesheets with no idempotency key, no duplicate detection, and no unique constraint on business keys. Submitting the same timesheet entry multiple times creates duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists. Agent retries or LLM non-determinism would create duplicate timesheet records.
findings.recommendation: Add unique constraint on (employee_id, entry_date, project). Implement idempotency key support in write operations.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses only ASP.NET Forms Authentication (human credential-based login). No machine identity authentication exists — no OAuth2 client credentials, no API key authentication, no mTLS, no service account mechanism.
findings.gap: No machine identity mechanism. An agent cannot authenticate without using human credentials, preventing audit attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials for programmatic access with per-agent principal attribution.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. Write operations execute without recording the authenticated principal, timestamp, or any audit trail. No CloudTrail, no application-level logging, no immutable log storage.
findings.gap: Zero audit trail for any operation. Cannot prove who performed any action or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with principal attribution for all write operations stored in immutable medium.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: Write operations execute as direct SQL INSERT statements with no transaction management, no compensation logic, and no rollback capability. Partial state persists with no recovery mechanism.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no undo endpoints, no compensating transactions. Cannot reverse a completed write operation.
findings.recommendation: Implement transaction management, soft-delete patterns, and compensation endpoints.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Employee work data stored in SQL Server with no data residency controls, no compliance documentation, no region enforcement. No guardrails prevent agent transmission of employee data across jurisdictions.
findings.gap: No data residency configuration, no sovereignty documentation, no controls preventing cross-border data transmission.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements for employee data. Implement guardrails to prevent cross-border LLM transmission.

findings.title: No immutable audit logging for write operations
findings.description: No immutable audit logging configured. Write operations do not log the authenticated principal. The deleteProduct resolver acknowledges this gap in a code comment.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit trail recording which principal performed each write operation. No CloudTrail configuration. No application-level audit event emission on mutations.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudTrail configuration with log file validation and S3 bucket with object lock. Emit structured audit events from mutation resolvers capturing JWT sub claim, action, and timestamp.

findings.title: Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints POST /orders, POST /orders/:id/refund, and POST /orders/:id/cancel lack idempotency key support. The refund endpoint explicitly risks double-refunding on retry.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists for any write operation. Agent retries or LLM duplicate tool calls will create duplicate orders, issue double refunds, or trigger duplicate warehouse cancellations.
findings.recommendation: Add Idempotency-Key header support to POST /orders and POST /orders/:id/refund using a deduplication table or cache with TTL.

findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No application-level audit logging exists. Write operations do not log the authenticated principal, action taken, or affected resource. CloudWatch logs configured but no structured audit events emitted.
findings.gap: Cannot attribute any write action to a specific agent or user identity. No tamper-evident audit trail for compliance or forensics.
findings.recommendation: Add structured audit log emission on every write operation capturing: principal (from JWT), action, resource_id, timestamp, and outcome. Store in immutable log (S3 Object Lock).

findings.title: Compensation and Rollback
findings.description: All three write operations are explicitly irreversible: hardDelete removes the row permanently, refund issues real money movement, cancelAndRecallShipment triggers physical warehouse dispatch recall. No saga pattern, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints.
findings.gap: An agent executing a multi-step workflow that fails mid-sequence leaves the system in an unrecoverable partial state. No rollback or compensation mechanism exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement soft-delete for orders. Add idempotency to refund. Implement saga pattern with compensating transactions for multi-step operations.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: System stores customer PII (customerId) and financial data (totalCents). GET /orders/:id uses SELECT * returning all columns without field filtering. No DTOs or field-level exclusion. Single orders:write role grants access to all data.
findings.gap: Agent-facing API returns all database fields including PII without scoping. No access control differentiates sensitive from non-sensitive data access.
findings.recommendation: Replace SELECT * with explicit column selection excluding PII. Create separate authorized endpoints for PII access. Add OAuth scopes for data-domain differentiation.

findings.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
findings.description: Customer PII and financial data stored in RDS with no documented residency controls. No GDPR/LGPD compliance references. No region-specific data controls. CloudFormation deploys to AWS::Region but imposes no cross-region constraints.
findings.gap: No documented data residency policy, no technical controls preventing cross-region data transmission for customer financial/PII data.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Add region-restriction tags to IaC resources. Implement VPC endpoints for LLM APIs ensuring data stays in-region.

findings.title: Write endpoints lack idempotency
findings.description: Write endpoints (POST /api/orders, POST /api/returns, POST /api/admin/users) use uniqid() for ID generation with no idempotency key support. Repeated calls create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency key parameter accepted on any write endpoint. No unique business-key constraints prevent duplicate creation on retry.
findings.recommendation: Implement X-Idempotency-Key header support on all POST endpoints that stores and deduplicates requests within a 24-hour window.

findings.title: No machine identity authentication
findings.description: Authentication is exclusively session-based using PHP sessions with username/password login via HTML form. No OAuth2 client credentials, no API key authentication, no mTLS support.
findings.gap: No machine identity mechanism exists. An agent cannot authenticate programmatically with principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key authentication with principal attribution or OAuth2 client credentials flow for /api/* endpoints.

findings.title: No immutable audit logging
findings.description: Order status changes logged to mutable MySQL table (order_status_history). No immutable log storage, no CloudTrail, no tamper-evident logging.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit trail. Database records can be modified or deleted.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudTrail with log file validation enabled and route application audit events to CloudWatch Logs with KMS encryption.

findings.title: No compensation or rollback for multi-step workflows
findings.description: Individual operations use DB transactions but the multi-step fulfillment workflow (validate → assign → pick → pack → QC → ship → deliver) has no compensation logic. Each step commits independently.
findings.gap: No saga pattern. No compensating transactions. No undo endpoints for fulfillment steps.
findings.recommendation: Implement compensation endpoints for each fulfillment step and adopt saga pattern with rollback states.

findings.title: No data residency controls for stored PII
findings.description: Customer PII (names, emails, addresses, payment records) stored with no data residency controls or documentation. No mechanism prevents an agent from transmitting PII to an LLM in a different jurisdiction.
findings.gap: No data residency policy. No region restrictions. No data classification. No compliance controls.
findings.recommendation: Document applicable data residency requirements, classify stored data, and configure AWS region restrictions via SCPs.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single shared database password provides full access. No concept of scoped permissions — every user and potential agent gets identical full-access credentials.
findings.gap: No authorization model exists. Cannot grant agent read-only access or restrict by resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with scoped IAM policies in replacement API layer. Define per-agent permission sets.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. INSERT operations execute without any permission check. No mechanism to allow read but prevent write/delete.
findings.gap: No ABAC, RBAC, or permission matrix. All callers can perform all operations.
findings.recommendation: Design fine-grained permission model (read/write/delete per resource type) in replacement API.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. Environ("USERNAME") is a local environment variable read, not a delegation framework. No JWT, OAuth token exchange, or on-behalf-of flow.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user. No token exchange pattern.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 on-behalf-of flow with distinct auth flows for service-to-service vs user-delegated calls.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database password 'crm2005pw' hardcoded as a constant in VB6 source. No secrets management, no rotation, visible to anyone with source access.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in source code with no rotation, no secrets manager, no environment-variable abstraction.

findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable vs terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error responses with error code, message, and retryable flag.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: All partners share the same credential mechanism with identical access. No scoped permissions, no IAM policies, no per-partner differentiation.
findings.gap: Single shared authorization level for all callers. Cannot limit agent access to specific resources.
findings.recommendation: Introduce OAuth 2.0 scopes or API Gateway resource policies with per-agent permission boundaries.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Single operation with no action-level authorization. No RBAC/ABAC. Cannot restrict agent to read-only access.
findings.gap: No fine-grained authorization model to differentiate read vs write permissions.
findings.recommendation: Introduce action-level authorization (read vs write permissions) when migrating to REST.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT parsing, no OAuth token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No ability to carry user context for delegated agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation or OAuth 2.0 token exchange.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database credentials hardcoded in source: DB_PASS = 'partner2009'. No secrets management system. Partner credentials in flat properties file.
findings.gap: Credentials exposed in source control. No rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove all hardcoded credentials.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No per-identity revocation. Shared credentials prevent individual agent suspension. Revoking one partner impacts all.
findings.gap: Cannot suspend a misbehaving agent without impacting all callers.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent API keys or OAuth client IDs with individual revocation.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conditional writes. Concurrent agent calls could create conflicting records.
findings.gap: Raw INSERT with no conflict detection or resolution.
findings.recommendation: Add UNIQUE constraints and implement optimistic locking.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. JDBC connection has no timeout. Connection leak on error (no finally block).
findings.gap: Database failures cascade directly to callers. No resilience patterns.
findings.recommendation: Add connection pooling with timeout, try-with-resources, and circuit breaker pattern.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application-level throttling.
findings.gap: Unlimited request acceptance. Runaway agent loops unprotected.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling.

findings.title: No Business Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on agent-initiated operations. No maximum orders per hour, no spend limits.
findings.gap: Only physical database capacity bounds agent impact.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-caller business transaction limits.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: No query endpoints exist. Write-only interface. Agent cannot inspect current state before acting.
findings.gap: No GET/query operations available.
findings.recommendation: Add GET endpoints for order status queries when migrating to REST.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. Orders committed immediately on submission with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: All write operations immediately committed. No mechanism for agent-proposed writes to be reviewed.
findings.recommendation: Add order status lifecycle (PENDING → CONFIRMED → CANCELLED).

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflows. All operations execute immediately without human oversight.
findings.gap: No operation-level approval configuration for high-risk actions.
findings.recommendation: Implement amount-based approval thresholds for high-value operations.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Testing is manual SOAP-UI sessions against production.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized staging environment with synthetic data.

findings.title: No Access Control Differentiation for Sensitive Data
findings.description: Financial transaction data stored with single shared credential granting full access. B1 (response scoping) is CLEAR. B2 (access differentiation) fires — no granularity. B3 (classification) absent.
findings.gap: Single shared credential provides full access to all financial transaction data with no role differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access with data-domain granularity (separate scopes for order submission vs data retrieval).

findings.title: Raw Exception Messages Leak System Information
findings.description: Raw exception messages returned to callers (ERROR: + e.getMessage()) may expose database details, SQL errors, or system internals. No PII redaction.
findings.gap: No redaction of sensitive information in error responses.
findings.recommendation: Return generic error codes; log details server-side with PII masking.

findings.title: Zero Input Validation — SQL Injection and XXE Vulnerabilities
findings.description: No input validation. SQL injection via string concatenation. XXE vulnerability in XML parsing. No parameterized queries, no sanitization.
findings.gap: Malformed agent payloads would corrupt data or enable attacks.
findings.recommendation: Use PreparedStatement, enable XXE protection on DocumentBuilderFactory, add input validation.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata
findings.description: INSERT stores no timestamps. No created_at, updated_at, or freshness indicators.
findings.gap: Cannot determine when data was created or modified.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at timestamp columns with UTC normalization.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or Breaking Change Detection
findings.description: Hand-maintained WSDL drifts from implementation. No versioning, no changelog, no breaking change detection in CI.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings would break silently on any implementation change.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs, no logging framework.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated request failures are undiagnosable.
findings.recommendation: Add structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and integrate OpenTelemetry.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No alerting on error rates or latency. No CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring.
findings.gap: Service degradation affecting agents goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rates and p95 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK). Infrastructure presumed manually managed.
findings.gap: No IaC, no peer review on infra changes, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as code with peer review requirements.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Build is manual Ant with wsgen/wsimport run by hand. No automated testing.
findings.gap: No pipeline, no contract testing, no breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract tests.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployment automation or rollback. Manual WAR deployment on JBoss.
findings.gap: Broken deployments have no automated recovery path.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployments with rollback (blue/green or canary).

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README confirms testing is manual SOAP-UI sessions.
findings.gap: No API tests validating input handling, output format, or error responses.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API tests covering happy path, validation, and error cases.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Oracle 11g end-of-life with no TDE or KMS configuration.
findings.gap: Financial data stored unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest; migrate to RDS with KMS customer-managed keys.

findings.title: No Asynchronous Operation Support
findings.description: The payroll batch runs 5-7 hours with no async patterns, no job status API, no polling endpoint, and no webhook callback.
findings.gap: Long-running operations have no async support. Agent cannot submit a job and poll for status.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job submission pattern with status polling endpoint.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. No IAM policies, no role-based access, no mechanism to grant scoped access.
findings.gap: No scoped permissions capability. Any caller has full access to all operations and data.
findings.recommendation: Implement IAM-based authorization with resource-level scoping.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Cannot distinguish read from write permissions. No ABAC, no fine-grained RBAC.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce action-level access control for agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Design action-level authorization into the modernized API with separate read/write/admin scopes.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT parsing, no OAuth token exchange, no user context headers.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange for identity propagation when building the API surface.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Control
findings.description: FTP credentials hardcoded in plaintext in JCL: username 'payroll' and password 'PayR0ll2003!'. No secrets management system used.
findings.gap: Exposed credentials in source control with no rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Rotate credentials immediately. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Capability
findings.description: No identity management or suspension capability exists. No API keys to revoke, no IAM roles to deactivate, no service accounts to disable.
findings.gap: Cannot suspend individual agent identities without shutting down the entire system.
findings.recommendation: Design agent identity lifecycle management (issuance, suspension, revocation) into the modernized architecture.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: No queryable state endpoints. Employee data locked in VSAM indexed files and DB2 on mainframe with no query interface.
findings.gap: Agent cannot inspect current state before deciding next steps.
findings.recommendation: Implement queryable state endpoints for employee records and pay run history.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. Sequential file access with no optimistic locking, no version fields, no conflict detection.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent instances could corrupt state with no race condition protection.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking and mutual exclusion on batch runs.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. FTP transfer to EC2 gateway has no timeout, no retry, no circuit breaker.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns for external dependencies. Gateway failures cascade without protection.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker and retry patterns for all external dependency calls.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. Batch processes ALL employee records with no cap on records modified, no spend limits.
findings.gap: No blast radius limits. Erroneous agent invocation processes entire employee base.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable transaction limits (max employees per run, max total payout amount).

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. All operations commit immediately with no two-step approval workflow.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose payroll run for human review before execution.
findings.recommendation: Implement draft/pending state for payroll runs where results are staged for human approval.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. All operations execute immediately without human oversight option.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk operations.
findings.recommendation: Design configurable approval gates using Step Functions with waitForTaskToken.

findings.title: Inadequate Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: Only a shared QA region exists on the mainframe — not a dedicated sandbox with production-equivalent data shape for agent testing.
findings.gap: No isolated sandbox for agent testing with production-equivalent data.
findings.recommendation: Provision a dedicated sandbox environment with anonymized payroll data for agent testing.

findings.title: No Selective Query Support
findings.description: No selective query capability. Batch processes all employee records sequentially. No pagination, filtering, or sorting.
findings.gap: Agent cannot query a subset of data — all-or-nothing batch processing.
findings.recommendation: Implement filtered query endpoints with pagination in the modernized API.

findings.title: No Input Validation
findings.description: No input validation at any boundary. COBOL reads fixed-width records with no field validation. No API boundary, no schema enforcement.
findings.gap: No validation. Malformed data processed without rejection.
findings.recommendation: Implement schema validation with structured error responses in the modernized API.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata
findings.description: No temporal metadata. Employee record structure contains no created_at, updated_at, or event_time fields. No timezone handling.
findings.gap: Cannot determine when data was last updated or whether it is current.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at timestamps (UTC) to all persistent records.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction. SSN and bank account numbers flow through the system without masking in any output.
findings.gap: PII (SSN, bank accounts) exposed in processing outputs without redaction.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking for SSN and bank account numbers in all logs and observability data.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning
findings.description: No schema versioning. Fixed-width file format (120-byte records) with no version identifier, no schema documentation, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: Schema changes would break consumers silently. No versioning or contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Define and version the data schema. Implement OpenAPI specification with breaking change detection.

findings.title: No Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. Changes validated in shared QA region only.
findings.gap: Zero automated test coverage. API behavior changes cannot be caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated test suite covering payroll calculations and integration points.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Employee master and pay output files contain SSN and bank accounts stored unencrypted. DB2 v10 (end of support) with no encryption.
findings.gap: Sensitive data stored unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Implement encryption at rest using KMS for all sensitive data stores.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. The application has no concept of permissions, roles, or access scopes. Every caller has identical unrestricted access to all pricing data.
findings.gap: No mechanism to create scoped permissions for different callers.
findings.recommendation: Implement API Gateway usage plans with per-key scoping to differentiate agent access levels.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No authorization enforcement exists at any level. The application cannot distinguish between callers with different permission levels.
findings.gap: No action-level authorization. Cannot restrict agents to specific product categories.
findings.recommendation: Add role-based access control at the gateway layer with method-level restrictions.

findings.title: No Input Validation — Buffer Overflow and XSS
findings.description: No input validation exists. The parse_query function uses strcpy to copy attacker-controlled query string data into fixed-size buffers without length checks (buffer overflow). The SKU parameter is reflected directly into HTML output without escaping (XSS). No bounds checking on qty parameter.
findings.gap: Zero input validation at API boundary. Active security vulnerabilities (buffer overflow, XSS).
findings.recommendation: Rewrite input parsing with bounded string operations (strncpy, length validation). Add SKU format validation. Escape HTML output. Return structured errors for invalid inputs.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema documentation, no breaking change detection. The CGI endpoint has no version prefix, no changelog, and no contract tests.
findings.gap: No schema versioning or API contracts. Agent tool bindings have no stability guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI specification. Add URL versioning (/v1/pricing). Implement contract tests in CI.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, or any machine-readable API specification exists in the repository.
findings.gap: Agent frameworks cannot auto-generate tool definitions. Manual tool authoring required.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting GET /rates and POST /quote.

findings.title: Unstructured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses are minimal objects with generic error strings. No error codes, no retryable indicators, no machine-readable categories.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured errors with error_code, message, and retryable fields.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: A single shared API key grants equal access to all endpoints. There is no mechanism to create scoped permissions — all callers get identical access.
findings.gap: No authorization model supporting differentiated access levels per caller identity.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller API keys with associated permission scopes at the API Gateway layer.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. The API key check is a binary pass/fail that grants access to all endpoints equally. No RBAC, no ABAC, no per-method checks.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict an agent to specific operations (e.g., GET only, no POST).
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level checks via API Gateway method-level authorization or route middleware.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: The API key is hardcoded in source code (var API_KEY = 'ship-2013-abc123-static'). The MongoDB connection URL with internal IP is also hardcoded. No secrets management system.
findings.gap: No secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault). No credential rotation. Credentials committed to git history permanently.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials. Read from environment variables. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of any kind. No request logging, no principal attribution in logs, no CloudTrail, no immutable log storage. Only console.log at startup.
findings.gap: Cannot determine which caller made which request. No audit trail for forensics or compliance.

findings.title: Cannot Suspend Individual Agent Identities
findings.description: Single shared API key means individual agent identities cannot be suspended. Revoking the key disables all callers simultaneously.
findings.gap: No ability to isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting all other consumers.
findings.recommendation: Move to per-caller API keys managed through API Gateway with independent revocation.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations on MongoDB connection. Each request opens a new connection with no timeout. MongoDB failures cascade to all callers.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns protect against dependency failures. Slow or unreachable MongoDB hangs requests indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Add connection timeouts, connection pooling, and circuit breaker pattern for MongoDB dependency.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting

findings.gap: Runaway agent loops can overwhelm the service and MongoDB at machine speed with no throttling.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment

findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior.

findings.gap: No validation library, no schema enforcement, no structured validation errors.
