findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting thresholds configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no incident management integration.
findings.gap: System degradation goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rate and p95 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual deployment via Capistrano 2 to fixed EC2 hosts. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: Infrastructure not defined as code, not peer-reviewed, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as Terraform or CloudFormation.

findings.title: No CI/CD or Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CodeBuild. No automated testing in deployment.
findings.gap: API changes cannot be caught before agents are affected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: Rollback Capability Unverifiable
findings.description: Capistrano 2 has implicit rollback but no deployment configuration exists in the repository to confirm.
findings.gap: Rollback capability not verifiable from repository contents.
findings.recommendation: Add deployment configuration to repository. Implement automated rollback triggers.

findings.title: No Working Test Suite
findings.description: No working test suite. README states tests are stale and non-functional. No test files in repository.
findings.gap: No automated verification of API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Create integration test suite covering all endpoints.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest for MySQL 5.1 storing PCI card data. No KMS, no encrypted storage configuration.
findings.gap: PCI-regulated card data likely stored unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest via KMS or migrate to RDS with encryption.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single database user (ts_app) with full access to all data. No mechanism to scope permissions per caller. All authenticated users share the same database-level access.
findings.gap: No authorization model supports scoped permissions. Cannot grant read-only agent access without inheriting write access.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control with separate database credentials per role.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. Any authenticated user can perform any operation. No distinction between read, write, or delete permissions.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict an agent to read-only without granting insert capability. No ABAC, no fine-grained RBAC.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization middleware with canRead/canWrite checks.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: Session-based identity (Session("EmployeeId")) cannot propagate through service calls. No JWT, no OAuth2 on-behalf-of flows, no token exchange. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity delegation framework for agent-on-behalf-of-user workflows.
findings.recommendation: Replace session identity with JWT tokens supporting on-behalf-of delegation flows.

findings.title: Plaintext Credentials in Source Control
findings.description: Database credentials stored in plaintext in web.config committed to source control (Password=Time2006!). No secrets management, no rotation, no encryption.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credentials in source control. No Secrets Manager, no rotation mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Rotate compromised password immediately.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. No concept of agent identity exists. Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting all authentication.
findings.gap: No identity lifecycle management or revocation capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement agent identity lifecycle with immediate suspension when building machine identity layer.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no If-Match headers. Multiple concurrent agent instances could write simultaneously without conflict detection.
findings.gap: No mechanism prevents race conditions from concurrent agent writes.
findings.recommendation: Add version column and implement optimistic locking for write operations.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience
findings.description: No resilience patterns for SQL Server dependency. No circuit breaker, no retry logic, no timeout configuration. Database failures cascade unhandled.
findings.gap: No circuit breaker, no retry, no timeout. Failures propagate unhandled.
findings.recommendation: Implement connection timeouts, retry with exponential backoff, and circuit breaker patterns.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on write operations. An agent could INSERT unlimited timesheet entries without any cap on records, hours, or operations per session.
findings.gap: No business-domain transaction limits. No per-session operation caps.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller business limits (max entries/day, max hours/entry).

findings.title: State Not Programmatically Queryable
findings.description: Current state is queried by BindGrid() but only rendered as HTML grid. No programmatic query endpoint for agent inspection.
findings.gap: Agent cannot programmatically inspect current state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Expose GET /timesheets endpoint returning JSON when building API layer.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. INSERT immediately commits records permanently. No intermediate state for human review before finalization.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose entries for human review before commitment.
findings.recommendation: Add status column with PENDING/APPROVED states. Implement two-step workflow.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. All operations execute immediately without human approval step. No operation-level configuration for requiring approval.
findings.gap: Cannot configure operations to require human approval before execution.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations (unusual hours, retroactive entries).

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single production server only. Testing agents means testing against production data.
findings.gap: No non-production environment for safe agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized staging environment with synthetic data.

findings.title: No Access Control Differentiation for Sensitive Data
findings.description: Employee data stored (employee_id, hours, project). Single DB user with undifferentiated access to all employee data. No mechanism to distinguish sensitive from non-sensitive access.
findings.gap: No access control differentiation. All data equally accessible to any authenticated caller.
findings.recommendation: Implement row-level security and access scoping. Create separate views for agent access.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction mechanism. Debug mode enabled and custom errors disabled expose sensitive data in error responses. No log scrubbing framework exists.
findings.gap: No PII protection infrastructure. Error disclosure exposes sensitive data paths.
findings.recommendation: Disable debug mode, enable custom errors. Implement PII redaction when adding logging.

findings.title: No Pagination or Filtering
findings.description: BindGrid() retrieves all entries with no pagination, no filtering beyond employee_id, no result size limits.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets returned. Years of history in single query.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination and date-range filtering.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: Zero input validation. User input concatenated directly into SQL strings. Critical SQL injection vulnerabilities. System accepts any input shape.
findings.gap: No type checking, no range validation, no parameterized queries. SQL injection is critical.
findings.recommendation: Replace all string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries immediately. Add input validation.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Only user-provided entry_date. No system timestamps (created_at, updated_at). No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Cannot determine when records were created or modified. No data currency signals.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at/updated_at columns with UTC defaults.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no migration files, no API contracts, no breaking change detection. Database schema only inferable from SQL strings in code.
findings.gap: Schema changes untracked and undetectable.
findings.recommendation: Implement schema migration tooling (Flyway/DbUp) with versioned files.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC exists. Manual provisioning on end-of-life Windows Server 2003 / IIS 6. No peer review, no drift detection.
findings.gap: Zero infrastructure governance. Manual provisioning with no auditability.
findings.recommendation: Define all resources as IaC (Terraform/CDK) when modernizing infrastructure.

findings.title: No Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. No unit tests, integration tests, API tests, or contract tests. Zero test coverage.
findings.gap: Cannot validate behavior, catch regressions, or verify agent paths.
findings.recommendation: Build test suite covering API endpoints, input validation, and error responses.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No encryption at rest. Employee data stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: Data at rest unencrypted. Accessible to anyone with storage-level access.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to modern database (RDS) with encryption at rest via KMS.

findings.title: No structured error code taxonomy
findings.description: Apollo Server provides GraphQL-standard error responses but no custom error code taxonomy distinguishing retriable from terminal errors.
findings.gap: No error code taxonomy. Agents cannot programmatically distinguish retriable from terminal errors without parsing message strings.
findings.recommendation: Add custom GraphQLError subclasses with extensions.code values (FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, RATE_LIMITED) and retryable boolean.

findings.title: No identity propagation or agent-vs-user distinction
findings.description: JWT claims are extracted from the API Gateway authorizer context. However, there is no mechanism to distinguish between an agent acting under its own identity vs. acting on behalf of a user.
findings.gap: No on-behalf-of flow or token exchange pattern. No code logic differentiating agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement separate Cognito app clients for agent vs user callers with custom claims for actor type differentiation.

findings.title: No concurrency controls on write operations
findings.description: No optimistic locking or concurrency controls. upsertProduct uses unconditional db.put() — last-write-wins with no version field or conditional expression.
findings.gap: No version field, no ETag, no DynamoDB conditional writes. Multiple concurrent agents writing to the same SKU will silently overwrite each other.
findings.recommendation: Add a version field and DynamoDB ConditionExpression to detect concurrent modification. Return a conflict error when the condition fails.

findings.title: No per-client rate limiting configured
findings.description: The SAM HttpApi does not configure explicit throttling. No per-client rate limiting, no WAF rate rules, no usage plan.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loop not throttled beyond account-wide API Gateway defaults (10,000 req/s).
findings.recommendation: Add API Gateway throttle configuration per route and per client. Deploy WAF WebACL with rate-based rules.

findings.title: No business transaction limits per agent identity
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. Each mutation affects one record but no cap on total mutations per session or per hour per agent identity.
findings.gap: No per-session or per-identity business transaction limits. An agent could loop and modify all products rapidly.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-identity mutation counters in DynamoDB with configurable thresholds per time window.

findings.title: No draft/pending state for agent-proposed changes
findings.description: No draft or pending state concept. upsertProduct immediately commits. deleteProduct immediately soft-deletes. No intermediate state for human review.
findings.gap: All mutations are immediately effective. Agents cannot propose changes for human review before committing.
findings.recommendation: Add a status enum field (DRAFT, ACTIVE) to the product schema. Agent-initiated mutations create products in DRAFT status.

findings.title: No configurable approval gates for mutations
findings.description: No approval gate mechanism. All mutations execute immediately when the caller has catalog:write scope. No configurable flag to require human confirmation.
findings.gap: No operation-level approval configuration. No Step Functions with human approval tasks.
findings.recommendation: Add Step Functions approval workflow for deleteProduct using waitForTaskToken for human confirmation.

findings.title: No sandbox/staging environment for agent testing
findings.description: No staging or sandbox environment configuration. No docker-compose, no seed data, no environment-specific configs.
findings.gap: No safe environment for testing agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Add docker-compose with DynamoDB Local and seed data for local agent testing. Create samconfig.toml with staging profile.

findings.title: Incomplete temporal metadata and no freshness signaling
findings.description: Products have updatedAt field (UTC ISO 8601) but no createdAt timestamp. No freshness signaling to agents (no Cache-Control headers, no data-age indicators).
findings.gap: Missing createdAt field. No mechanism for agents to determine data currency.
findings.recommendation: Add createdAt to Product type. Consider adding freshness response headers or envelope fields.

findings.title: No breaking change detection for schema
findings.description: GraphQL schema is schema-first and version-controlled but no breaking change detection in CI, no consumer-driven contract tests.
findings.gap: Schema changes could break agent tool bindings without early detection. No schema diff tooling.
findings.recommendation: Integrate graphql-inspector or similar schema diff tool into CI to flag breaking changes before merge.

findings.title: No structured logging with correlation IDs
findings.description: X-Ray active tracing enabled for distributed tracing. No structured JSON logging implemented in application code. No correlation ID propagation.
findings.gap: Application-level structured logs with correlation IDs missing. Only X-Ray trace-level visibility.
findings.recommendation: Add @aws-lambda-powertools/logger for structured JSON logging with automatic correlation ID and X-Ray trace ID propagation.

findings.title: No alerting configured for API degradation
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms configured in the SAM template. No alerting thresholds for error rates or latency.
findings.gap: API degradation will not trigger notifications. No proactive detection of agent-impacting issues.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda error count, duration P99, and API Gateway 5xx rate.

findings.title: IaC present but no review workflow or drift detection
findings.description: Infrastructure defined as code in SAM template. No CI/CD pipeline enforces peer review. No drift detection configured.
findings.gap: Two of three governance sub-checks unmet: no automated plan review and no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with sam validate and changeset review. Enable AWS Config rules for drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline or contract testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration in repository. No contract tests or schema validation in builds.
findings.gap: No automated pipeline. Schema changes not validated before deployment.
findings.recommendation: Create CI pipeline with TypeScript compilation, vitest, and graphql-inspector on every PR.

findings.title: No rollback capability configured
findings.description: No deployment preference or rollback configuration. No canary, no blue/green, no automatic rollback triggers.
findings.gap: Broken deployment requires manual intervention to restore service.
findings.recommendation: Add AutoPublishAlias and DeploymentPreference with Canary10Percent5Minutes and alarm-based rollback.

findings.title: Zero test coverage for API endpoints
findings.description: Test framework configured (vitest in package.json) but no test files exist in the repository.
findings.gap: No automated tests. API behavior changes cannot be caught before deployment.
findings.recommendation: Create resolver integration tests with DynamoDB mocks covering query, mutation, auth, and error cases.

findings.title: Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification exists at openapi/orders.yaml but lacks request body and response body schemas. Only status codes and descriptions provided.
findings.gap: Spec is incomplete — no request/response schemas for automated agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Add request body schemas and response schemas using $ref components. Consider auto-generating from Fastify route schemas.

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Consistent {code, message} error structure present for 401, 403, and 404 responses. No retryable boolean or error category included.
findings.gap: Missing retryable/terminal distinction. Agents must guess whether to retry on failure.
findings.recommendation: Add retryable boolean and error category to error response format.

findings.title: Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Authorization uses orders:read and orders:write roles. All write operations share a single role. An agent authorized to create orders inherits ability to hard-delete, refund, and cancel.
findings.gap: No action-level granularity within write operations. Cannot grant create without also granting delete and refund.
findings.recommendation: Split orders:write into granular roles: orders:create, orders:delete, orders:refund, orders:cancel.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: JWT verified but no on-behalf-of flow. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. No identity propagation to downstream warehouse calls.
findings.gap: No identity propagation to downstream services. Cannot attribute warehouse operations to originating user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange for agent-on-behalf-of-user operations. Propagate user identity to warehouse calls.

findings.title: Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: Authentication relies entirely on external JWKS JWT verification. No application-level token blocklist or identity suspension mechanism.
findings.gap: Cannot immediately block a compromised agent identity at the application layer.
findings.recommendation: Add token/principal blocklist middleware with Redis-backed cache. Expose admin endpoint to add principals to blocklist.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, ETag support, or conditional updates. UPDATE statements execute without checking current state.
findings.gap: Race conditions between concurrent agent instances will corrupt order state.
findings.recommendation: Add version column with optimistic locking. Return 409 Conflict on version mismatch.

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: OrderService calls external WarehouseClient with no circuit breaker, no retry logic, no timeout configuration, and no fallback handling.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns on external dependency calls. Runaway agent loops cascade failures to warehouse.
findings.recommendation: Add circuit breaker library (opossum) around WarehouseClient calls. Configure timeouts and retry with backoff.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no application-level rate limiting middleware, no WAF rules.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms overwhelming the service.
findings.recommendation: Add @fastify/rate-limit middleware. Deploy API Gateway with throttling for production.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No business-domain transaction limits. Agent could issue unlimited refunds, delete unlimited orders, or cancel unlimited shipments without per-session or per-hour caps.
findings.gap: Agent error blast radius is unbounded. No configurable limits on business impact of agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Add per-caller transaction limits: max_refunds_per_hour, max_deletes_per_session, max_refund_amount_per_day.

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: Order status limited to placed/shipped/cancelled/refunded. No draft or pending_review state. All writes execute immediately and irrevocably.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent-proposed changes to await human approval before commitment.
findings.recommendation: Add pending status values (pending_refund, pending_cancel) and confirm/reject endpoints.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflow. High-risk operations (refund, cancel, delete) execute immediately without configurable approval step.
findings.gap: Cannot configure high-risk operations to require human approval before execution.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable approval gates for refund (amount threshold) and cancel (always for shipped orders).

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment, docker-compose, seed data, or environment-specific configurations found.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL and seed data. Add staging environment parameter to CloudFormation.

findings.title: PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: CloudWatch logs configured but no PII redaction or log scrubbing. System handles customer PII with no log-level protection.
findings.gap: No PII redaction middleware or log scrubbing configuration.
findings.recommendation: Add structured logging configuration excluding sensitive fields. Integrate PII detection on CloudWatch log group.

findings.title: Input Validation and Schema Enforcement
findings.description: Request bodies cast without validation (req.body as Record<string, unknown>). No validation library in dependencies. Parameterized queries prevent SQL injection only.
findings.gap: No input validation at API boundary. Malformed agent payloads reach database layer.
findings.recommendation: Add typebox or zod schemas to Fastify route definitions with field-level validation.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: Order interface defines only id, customerId, status, totalCents. No created_at, updated_at, or event_time fields. No Cache-Control headers.
findings.gap: No temporal metadata on records. Agents cannot determine data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at columns. Include in API responses with Last-Modified header.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: OpenAPI spec versioned (2.1.0) and node-pg-migrate for DB migrations present. No API URL versioning, no breaking change detection, no contract tests, no CI pipeline.
findings.gap: No API versioning strategy. Agent tool bindings could break silently on deployment.
findings.recommendation: Add URL-based API versioning. Add OpenAPI diff tools and consumer-driven contract tests.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry/X-Ray instrumentation. No structured logging. No correlation IDs. CloudWatch receives unstructured container stdout.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests cannot be traced through the system.
findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node with auto-instrumentation and Fastify request ID generation.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms defined. No alerting thresholds for error rates or latency. No PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: Service degradation affecting agents goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for ALB 5XX count and target response time P99.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: CloudFormation IaC exists (infra/ecs.yaml) but no automated change review and no drift detection configured.
findings.gap: 1 of 3 governance sub-checks pass (IaC exists, but no review process or drift detection).
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with IaC plan review on PRs. Enable CloudFormation drift detection.

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists in the repository. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkinsfile, or buildspec.yml found.
findings.gap: No automated mechanism to detect API-breaking changes before production.
findings.recommendation: Create CI pipeline with lint, type-check, test, OpenAPI validation, and deployment gating.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Vitest configured in package.json but no test files exist. Zero test coverage for API endpoints.
findings.gap: No automated tests for any API endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Create test files for all routes. Test error cases. Add to CI pipeline.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: RDS resource not defined in available CloudFormation template. No StorageEncrypted or KmsKeyId properties visible for the database storing customer data.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest configuration verifiable for customer data store.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS in IaC with StorageEncrypted: true and customer-managed KMS key.

findings.title: No on-behalf-of-user identity propagation
findings.description: The system authenticates calling services via OAuth2 client-credentials and extracts client_id. However, no mechanism exists to distinguish an agent acting under its own service identity versus acting on behalf of a specific end-user. No token exchange or on-behalf-of flow is implemented.
findings.gap: No identity propagation for on-behalf-of-user scenarios. An agent calling this API cannot carry user context to scope actions by user permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange or add X-On-Behalf-Of header support with validation, allowing the system to distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.

findings.title: No concurrency controls on idempotency writes
findings.description: The _idempotent_put() function uses a non-atomic check-then-act pattern (get_item followed by put_item) without DynamoDB ConditionExpression. Concurrent requests with the same idempotency key could both pass the existence check and create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No conditional writes (ConditionExpression: attribute_not_exists) on the DynamoDB put_item calls. No optimistic locking or version fields.
findings.recommendation: Add ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(pk)' to the idempotency record put_item to ensure exactly-once semantics under concurrency.

findings.title: No business-level transaction limits
findings.description: No per-caller business transaction limits exist. Each API call creates exactly one charge or refund (limiting per-call blast radius), but no mechanism caps accumulated operations per time window (max charges per hour, max spend per session per client_id).
findings.gap: No business-level transaction limits. Only API-layer request throttling exists. A runaway agent loop could issue unlimited charges at API Gateway's throttle rate.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-client_id sliding window counters in DynamoDB to enforce configurable business limits (e.g., max_charges_per_hour=100, max_daily_spend=$50000).

findings.title: No draft/pending state for agent-proposed operations
findings.description: The OpenAPI schema defines status enum [pending, succeeded, failed], indicating the data model supports a pending state. However, the implementation always creates charges with status='succeeded' immediately. No code path produces a reviewable pending/draft state.
findings.gap: Schema supports pending state but implementation bypasses it. No reviewable intermediate state for agent-proposed operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement a pending code path where agent-initiated charges enter pending state requiring explicit confirmation via a new POST /charges/{id}/confirm endpoint.

findings.title: No configurable approval gates for high-risk operations
findings.description: No approval workflow exists. All operations execute immediately upon valid authentication and authorization. No configurable per-operation flags or Step Functions human approval tasks.
findings.gap: No mechanism to require human approval before high-risk operations execute.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval thresholds (e.g., charges > $1000 require human confirmation) or integrate Step Functions with waitForTaskToken for high-value operations.

findings.title: No automated breaking change detection in CI
findings.description: The OpenAPI spec is versioned (1.4.0), URL versioning is used (v1), and the spec is validated for structural correctness in CI. However, no automated breaking change detection exists (no oasdiff, no Pact, no schema comparison against previous versions).
findings.gap: No breaking change detection in CI pipeline. Backwards-incompatible changes could reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add oasdiff or similar tool to CI to compare spec against the previous released version and fail on breaking changes.

findings.title: No infrastructure drift detection
findings.description: Full integration surface defined in SAM IaC (API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, authorizer). CI runs on push and pull_request. However, no drift detection is configured (no AWS Config rules, no CloudFormation drift detection schedule).
findings.gap: No automated drift detection for deployed infrastructure. Manual changes to the deployed stack would not be detected.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudFormation drift detection on schedule or add AWS Config rules for API Gateway and IAM monitoring.

findings.title: No API backwards-compatibility checking in CI
findings.description: CI pipeline validates OpenAPI spec structure and runs pytest with contract tests. However, no breaking change detection tool (oasdiff, Pact) is integrated to catch backwards-incompatible API changes before they affect agent tool bindings.
findings.gap: CI validates spec correctness but not backwards compatibility. A removed field or changed type would pass CI but silently break agent tools.
findings.recommendation: Add oasdiff to CI pipeline to flag removed endpoints, changed request schemas, or narrowed response fields.

findings.title: No machine-readable API specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy specification. All 25+ API routes defined inline in index.php.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API specification file. Agent tool generation requires manual source code inspection.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all /api/* endpoints with request/response schemas.

findings.title: Unstructured error responses
findings.description: Error responses use simple {"error": "message"} format. No error codes, no retryable classification, no field-level detail.
findings.gap: No structured error taxonomy. Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error envelope: {"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "retryable": bool, "details": [...]}}.

findings.title: No action-level authorization within admin role
findings.description: Admin role has unrestricted access to all admin endpoints with no action-level granularity. Cannot grant read orders without delete users.
findings.gap: No fine-grained RBAC or ABAC within admin scope. Binary admin/customer distinction only.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level middleware mapping roles to permitted HTTP methods and URL patterns.

findings.title: No identity propagation or delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism exists. Session-based auth with no JWT/OAuth token exchange or on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user. No token-based delegation.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 with on-behalf-of token exchange allowing agents to carry delegated user identity.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential fallbacks in source code
findings.description: Database credentials have hardcoded fallback values in code (getenv('DB_PASS') ?: 'ecommerce_pass'). No secrets manager integration. No rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded fallback credentials. No AWS Secrets Manager or Vault. No rotation mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallbacks, integrate AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation for RDS credentials.

findings.title: No agent identity suspension mechanism
findings.description: User accounts can only be deleted entirely. No mechanism to suspend or disable without destroying the identity record.

findings.title: No concurrency controls for write operations

findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields on the orders table and conditional UPDATE statements.

findings.title: No rate limiting or throttling
findings.description: WAF has IP whitelisting but no rate-based rules. No application-level rate limiting. Runaway agent loops would not be throttled.

findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rules and implement application-level per-user request throttling.

findings.title: No blast radius or transaction limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. An agent with admin access could approve unlimited returns, delete unlimited users, or create unlimited orders without caps.
findings.gap: No per-caller business transaction limits. No batch caps. No spend thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-identity business transaction limits enforced at the application layer.

findings.title: No configurable approval gates
findings.description: Return approval is hardcoded. Cannot configure other operations to require approval without code changes.
findings.gap: No configurable operation-level approval flags. No approval workflow engine.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval framework that allows operations to be flagged for human approval by type or value threshold.

findings.title: No access control differentiation for sensitive data
findings.description: Stage A=YES (PII stored). B1=CLEAR (passwords excluded from responses). B2=FIRES (admin role grants undifferentiated access to all sensitive data). B3=absent.
findings.gap: Single admin role grants undifferentiated access to all data including customer PII and payment records. No OAuth scopes or granular permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based data access scoping with separate authorization for PII-containing endpoints.

findings.title: No PII redaction in logs or error responses
findings.description: PHP error logging enabled with no PII redaction. Exception messages exposed in API responses via json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]).

findings.recommendation: Replace raw exception messages with generic errors in API responses. Implement logging wrapper with PII redaction.

findings.title: No pagination on list endpoints

findings.gap: No pagination. No result size limits. Unbounded result sets.
findings.recommendation: Add limit and offset query parameters to all list endpoints with default limit of 50.

findings.title: Insufficient input validation with unstructured errors

findings.recommendation: Implement field-level validation with structured error responses identifying field, constraint, and accepted format.

findings.title: No freshness signaling despite timestamps existing

portfolio_level_findings.title: Centralized Identity Plane
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared identity provider detected across the portfolio. 11 of 14 services have AUTH-Q1 BLOCKER (no machine identity). No Cognito, Okta, or shared auth middleware found in any repo.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: AUTH-Q1 BLOCKER in 11 services. No shared IdP resource (Cognito User Pool ARN, Okta config) referenced across repos.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Deploy a centralized identity plane (Amazon Cognito or equivalent) shared by all services, with per-agent client credentials and principal attribution.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Cross-Service Audit Correlation
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared trace ID propagation or centralized audit trail detected. 11 services have AUTH-Q6 as BLOCKER (no audit logging at all). No shared CloudTrail, no consistent trace headers across repos.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: AUTH-Q6 BLOCKER in 11 services. No shared CloudTrail or centralized log aggregation found.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Implement centralized audit logging with shared CloudTrail trail, consistent trace ID headers (X-Amzn-Trace-Id), and centralized log aggregation.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Portfolio-Level Rate Limiting
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared API gateway or WAF protecting the portfolio perimeter. Only 1 service (modern-payments-api) has built-in rate limiting. 9 services have STATE-Q5 as RISK-SAFETY.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: STATE-Q5 findings across 9 services. No shared WAF WebACL or API Gateway referenced across repos.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Deploy a shared WAF WebACL with rate-based rules covering the portfolio perimeter. Implement per-agent traffic controls at the gateway layer.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Transitive Dependency Safety
portfolio_level_findings.finding: Dependencies inferred from report findings suggest modern-orders-service likely depends on services for warehouse operations. With 10 Not Agent-Integrable services, any ready service depending synchronously on them is effectively blocked.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: modern-orders-service calls WarehouseClient (external dependency). 10 services are Not Agent-Integrable.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Map service dependencies explicitly. Verify that pilot-eligible services do not have hard sync dependencies on Not Agent-Integrable services.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Agent Identity Governance
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No portfolio-wide agent identity registry or centralized revocation mechanism detected. Each service manages identities independently (where they exist at all). Only modern-payments-api has Cognito-based identity suspension.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: AUTH-Q7 RISK-SAFETY in 9 services, INFO in 3 services. Only 1 service (modern-payments-api) has native identity suspension.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Implement a centralized agent identity registry with portfolio-wide kill switch capability.
